Both renders exited 0 and no repo file changed.

unverified: make verify-airgap was not run; no change in this replay could invalidate it.
No real macOS/Tauri/MLX runtime behavior was exercised (no packaged app, no MLX serving or training).
No real Kubernetes/Colima cluster was started; the bridge was checked only by rendering manifests, not by DNS resolution from a pod or kubectl apply.
